sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried out 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Zakaria Mohamed Abd El Rehim, tested 
 by eng. Zakaria Mohamed Abd El Rehim accepted by general director eng. Osama 
 Ahmed Hasaneen revised by eng. Mohammed Osama Solima HPGC general 
 director quality control and approved by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abd El 
 gaber head sector of Aswan Hydraulic power station

السلامة 
الاحتياطات
يجب إصدار أمر العمل

The maintenance staff should be 
 qualified and carry the suitable ID safety category

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety helmet, shoes 
 breathing mask, safety glass ... etc

sections.text: Alarm system
Switch off MCE (FA) for alarm system
Racked out all electronic cards and clean it by vacuum cleaner and brush
Heck jumpers on each card
Racked in all cards
Switch on MCB (FA) and make function test for alarm system
Check the indication lamps and change the burned lamps

Check the electrical coupling between two sumps by key switch position 
 to(sump1+ sump2)
